incidents.summary: IHG was named in a US lawsuit alleging hotel-room price inflation, and the UK CMA subsequently opened an investigation into suspected sharing of competitively sensitive information through STR.

sources.title: CoStar named alongside hotel operators in class-action suit
sources.quote: Luxury hotel operators including Hilton, Hyatt and Marriott have been accused of conspiring with commercial real estate company CoStar to make room rates artificially high.

sources.title: CoStar named alongside hotel operators in class-action suit
sources.quote: Other defendants include IHG Hotels & Resorts, Loews Hotels and the U.S. subsidiary of Accor.

sources.title: CMA launches probe into Hilton, IHG and Marriott | Business Travel News Europe
sources.quote: The CMA said in a statement that it was investigating Marriott, Hilton and IHG Hotels & Resorts, alongside STR’s owner CoStar Group, as part of a probe into “suspected sharing” of sensitive information.

incidents.summary: Following an Office of Fair Trading allegation that IHG prevented online travel agents from discounting room-only accommodation, IHG agreed in February 2014 to end the price-fixing practice.

sources.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts
sources.quote: In July 2012, the Office of Fair Trading alleged that IHG had broken competition law by preventing online travel agents from discounting the price of room-only hotel accommodations.

sources.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts
sources.quote: In February 2014, IHG agreed to end the practice of price fixing.

incidents.summary: The ASA warned IHG to include VAT in advertised prices, and Which? subsequently reported that the company was continuing to violate VAT rules.

sources.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts
sources.quote: In May 2012, the UK Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) warned IHG that it must include VAT in its advertised prices.

sources.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts
sources.quote: In August 2012, a report by Which? magazine showed that IHG was continuing to violate VAT rules.

incidents.summary: Franchisees brought a class-action lawsuit against IHG alleging anti-competitive and fraudulent practices.

sources.title: Lawsuit against IHG adds plaintiffs; more predicted - AirGuide.info :: AirGuide Business – Aviation and Travel Business News + AirGuide Destinations – Airline and Travel News, Latest Aviation, Airline and Travel News | U.S. and Global Updates
sources.quote: Connecticut and Texas franchisees have joined a class action lawsuit filed by a Louisiana hotelier against the world’s largest hotel franchise operator, IHG Hotels & Resorts.

sources.title: Lawsuit against IHG adds plaintiffs; more predicted - AirGuide.info :: AirGuide Business – Aviation and Travel Business News + AirGuide Destinations – Airline and Travel News, Latest Aviation, Airline and Travel News | U.S. and Global Updates
sources.quote: An attorney for the plaintiffs says he expects many more franchisees will join the suit, which alleges a variety of anti-competitive and fraudulent practices.
